  %\VignetteIndexEntry{The geoChronR package family}

As of version 2.0, geoChronR is a thin wrapper. `library(geoChronR)` gives you the complete
interface of three focused packages, so code written for geoChronR 1.x keeps working:

| Package | Role |
|---|---|
| [agemodelR](https://github.com/nickmckay/agemodelR) | Age modeling with Bacon, Bchron, OxCal and BAM, plus LiPD model infrastructure |
| [ens](https://github.com/nickmckay/ens) | Ensemble correlation, regression, spectra, PCA, binning and data selection |
| [lipdViz](https://github.com/nickmckay/lipdViz) | Plotting and mapping |

If you only need part of this, for example ensemble methods without the age modeling software,
install and load just that package. The last release of the original single package is tag
`v1.1.19`, on the `monolith-1.x` branch. Worked examples are at
<https://nickmckay.github.io/GeoChronR/>.
